shape: Ordered nostr tag NAMES only (not values) for the two relay-signed/agent-signed event shapes this slice produces. `wakeTagNames` is the frozen tag order of build_spec.md 3.6 f, produced by crates/buzz-relay/src/delegation/dispatch.rs's dispatch_action and consumed positionally-agnostic (by name, not index) by crates/buzz-acp/src/delegation.rs's parse_delegation_binding. `wakeTagNamesContinuation` is the same list with the trailing continuation-only tag included, present only when the wake carries a child answer. `outcomeTagNames` is the frozen tag set of build_spec.md 4.4, produced by crates/buzz-acp/src/delegation.rs's build_outcome_event and consumed by crates/buzz-relay/src/delegation/mod.rs's settle_outcome. This file exists because Slice 3 shipped a routine wake tag list that a relay/sidecar pair briefly disagreed on ('a 3-element tag parsed as 2') -- the relay and sidecar sides here assert their own tag lists equal these arrays, so producer and consumer cannot silently drift. DEFECT FIX (D-L1, operator live-gate finding, 2026-09-16): the wake originally carried no `e` tags and no ThreadMetadataParams ancestry at all, contradicting spec 3.6 f's own prose ('threaded e root=reply=origin id') even though the tag-order enumeration in that same spec line omitted them -- the omission was a spec-internal inconsistency this build followed literally. Without real ancestry, the sidecar's outcome event (root=origin, parent=wake, per spec 4.4) was rejected by the relay's kind-9 thread-ancestry validator with 'root tag does not match thread ancestry', since the wake had no stored parent/root to resolve against. Fixed by adding two `e` tags (root=origin, reply=origin) to the wake and populating ThreadMetadataParams with parent_event_id=root_event_id=origin, so the wake's own ancestry resolves to root=origin exactly as the outcome event already (correctly) claims.
